parts.text: I keep the shared picture of the airspace by working with the network of flight corridors between sites, the zones grouping them, and the closures announced by the authorities. During my day, authorities announce closures that are planned with a start and end time or sudden ones that apply at once, and these closures are often amended while drones are already in the air. When a closure is entered, I want to know how much disruption it caused across customers. Because the service runs on a single server, it is updated and restarted during working hours while drones are flying, and it occasionally crashes, though our customers accept a few minutes of interruption.
